title: Practice 10: под- and от-: up to, and away from

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Мы ___ (отнести / относить — to carry, to deliver) его в мою хату.
exercises.why: Other: With transitive verbs, delivering or dropping something off (agent does not remain): Я отнесу книги в библиотеку, потом приду. — I'll drop the book off at the library, then come. — от + gen.. Подвозить — подвезти — to bring up to (by vehicle), to haul up to, to give a lift; относить — отнести — to take to (on foot); отвозить — отвезти — to take (haul) to; отводить — отвести — to take (lead) to. Note that the verbs "относить", "отвозить" and "отводить" are seldom used as opposites of the verbs with the prefix "под-". — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  From Николай Гоголь, «Вечера на хуторе близ Диканьки».
exercises.context: Other: With transitive verbs, delivering or dropping something off (agent does not remain): Я отнесу книги в библиотеку, потом приду. — I'll drop the book off at the library, then come. — от + gen..

exercises.q: Леон ___ (подлететь / подлетать — to fly up, to approach) к Сарре.
exercises.why: **подлете́ть** — **подлета́ть** — to fly up (to), to approach; (colloquial) to run/rush up (to). **подбежа́ть** — **подбега́ть** — to run up, to come running up to. **подплы́ть** — **подплыва́ть** — to swim or sail up to. **поднести́** — **подноси́ть** — to bring, to carry (to); to offer, to present. **подвести́** — **подводи́ть** — to lead (to) .mw-parser-output .object-usage-tag{font-style:italic}.mw-parser-output .deprecated{color:var(--wikt-palette-grey-lime-8,olivedrab)}[with к (k, + dative) ‘someone or something’]; to bring closer. — DLI, Lesson 29.  ·  From Николай Островский, «Рождённые бурей».
exercises.context: подлете́ть** — **подлета́ть — to fly up (to), to approach; (colloquial) to run/rush up (to).

exercises.q: И — дух от тела ___ (отлететь / отлетать — to fly away, to fly off)!
exercises.why: Verbs of motion with the prefix от- denote moving away from an object, a place or a person and require the preposition от + genitive case: Я отхожу от автомобиля. Студент отходит от учителя. Грузовик отъезжает от магазина. **под-, подо-** — Approach. — DLI, Lesson 29.  ·  From Михаил Лермонтов, «Боярин Орша».
exercises.context: Verbs of motion with the prefix от- denote moving away from an object, a place or a person and require the preposition от + genitive case: Я отхожу от автомобиля.

exercises.context: отлете́ть** — **отлета́ть — to fly away, to fly off; to rebound, to bounce back.
